name: comp-383
title: Avatar Notification Feed
description: A bell button with a red unread badge opens a popover feed. Each row pairs a user photo with a sentence about what they did, a timestamp and a dot for unread items; Mark all as read clears them.
use: A header needs a compact inbox of recent activity with clear unread markers.
avoid: The feed shows six fixed items with no scroll area, so a longer history crowds the popover.
a11y: The bell has an aria-label and avatars use names as alt, but unread status is shown only by a colour dot. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark card shows 'Activity', a grey '2 unread notifications' subtitle and a square bell button with a red count badge. The popover is a dark panel titled Notifications with a 'Mark all as read' link, a rule, and six rows of square avatars with two-line messages, grey timestamps and small unread dots.
behaves: Clicking the bell opens the feed. Clicking a row marks it read and removes its dot; Mark all as read clears every dot and removes the badge from the bell.
customise: The six notifications, avatar URLs, names, actions and timestamps are fixed in an array in the file; real data means replacing that array.
weight: light: A small popover with six image rows; no animation loop.
demo: Two unread; rows about a PR review, a shared library, an API task, auth flow and a dashboard.
issues: The popover is a fixed 320px wide and lists six items with no scroll area.
Unread state is conveyed only by a small dot, not to screen readers.
polishWhy: Tidy, scannable feed; a conventional popover with fixed width and no scrolling.
